name: paper-crypto-gemini
prompt: Paper-trading check for the BTC perpetual. Use the tradedesk search tool first to read the API, then work through execute. Step 1: call risk.status() and check mode FIRST. If the call errors, or risk.status().mode !== "paper", place nothing: report the error or mode and STOP. Also place nothing and stop if risk.status().killSwitch is true or risk.status().today.remainingOrders is 0, and report why. Step 2: call market.search({ query: "BTCUSD", exchange: "CRYPTO" }) and pick the BTC perpetual, whose symbol is the Delta symbol plus FUT (for example BTCUSDFUT). Ignore options and dated futures. If the result is ambiguous or has no such perpetual, place nothing and report it. This run is for that single symbol only; never loop and never trade any other instrument. Then call market.history for that symbol with exchange "CRYPTO", interval "1h" and a start/end range (YYYY-MM-DD) covering at least the last 3 days, so you have at least 21 candles. Step 3: apply exactly ONE rule: compute the simple moving average of the last 20 closes; if the latest close is above it, BUY; if below it, SELL (on a perpetual this opens a short); if equal, do nothing. Step 4: make at most ONE trade.place call in total: exchange CRYPTO, MARKET order, quantity 1 (never more than 1), product from risk.status().limits.allowedProducts (NRML or MIS). If trade.place is denied or errors, report the exact error text. After ANY failure, timeout, empty or unclear result, assume the order may have been placed: check account.orders() (read-only), report what you see, and NEVER call trade.place again, nor modify or place any other order. Always end with your reasoning: the symbol, the latest close, the SMA(20) value, the rule outcome and what you did. Never touch live mode; never use trade.cancel, trade.closePosition or trade.modify.
